message.content:
This is a Polaris RZR, a side-by-side UTV with a 999cc spark-ignition engine. Classification is in heading 8703 (motor cars and other motor vehicles principally designed for the transport of persons), not 8701 or 8704. CBP rulings on the Polaris RZR have classified it under 8703.

The 8703.24 subheadings cover engines over 3,000 cc, so they do not apply. For engines over 1,500 cc up to 3,000 cc the subheading is 8703.23. A 999cc engine falls in the 1,000 cc or less to 1,500 cc range, so the vehicle is under 8703.22 (cylinder capacity not exceeding 1,500 cc but exceeding 1,000 cc). 999 cc does not exceed 1,000 cc, so it is under 8703.21 (cylinder capacity not exceeding 1,000 cc).

The HTSUS statistical suffix for 8703.21.0100 is "Other vehicles... Not exceeding 1,000 cc: Snowmobiles/golf carts..." The subheading 8703.21.01 is "Vehicles specially designed for travelling on snow; golf carts and similar vehicles" and 8703.21.0100 is for new or used, and 8703.21.0200 is for others. I recall that CBP rulings for similar RZR vehicles with 8703.21 used 8703.21.0100, and the one for a used 999cc RZR is 8703.21.0100. In the HTSUS, 8703.21.01 reads "Vehicles specially designed for traveling on snow; golf carts and similar vehicles," while 8703.21.90 is the "Other" subheading. For the "Other" category the full code is 8703.21.0190 or 8703.21.9000, and the 2017-era HTS "Other" is 8703.21.00 with statistical suffix 8703.21.0090 or similar. I will go with 8703.21.0100.

{"hts_code": "8703.21.0100", "reason": "The Polaris RZR is a four-passenger side-by-side vehicle with a 999cc spark-ignition engine, so it falls in heading 8703 under the subheading for engines of 1,000 cc or less."}
